requirements.description: Microsoft FY2025 10-K: the reportable segments (three segments) and, for each, the lead-in qualifier and full list of main businesses, including the blocks immediately before and after each list to show where it begins and ends (Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, More Personal Computing). Optionally corroborate with the segment information note.
